camel_example: aliyun eas GET /api/v2/virtualresources --region cn-hangzhou --Order Desc --VirtualResourceName MyVirtualResource --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --VirtualResourceId 'eas-vr-npovr28onap1xxxxxx' --Sort CreateTime --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Queries the virtual resource groups for the current user
description_zh: 获取当前用户的虚拟资源组列表
kebab_example: aliyun eas list-virtual-resource --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --virtual-resource-id eas-vr-npovr28onap1xxxxxx --virtual-resource-name MyVirtualResource --sort CreateTime --order Desc --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListVirtualResource

parameters.help_en: The page number for the list of virtual resource groups. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟资源组列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of virtual resource groups to display on each page. The default value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的虚拟资源组数量，默认为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual resource group
parameters.name: virtual_resource_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the virtual resource group
parameters.name: virtual_resource_name

parameters.help_en: The field that is used to sort the results. By default, the results are sorted by timestamp in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。按时间戳类型默认倒序排序
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order. Valid values:

Desc: Descending order.

Asc: Ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，取值如下：
Desc：降序。
Asc：升序
parameters.name: order

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned list of virtual resource groups
PageNumber.description_zh: 返回查询的虚拟资源组列表的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of virtual resource groups returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 返回每页显示的虚拟资源组数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of virtual resource groups

VirtualResources.description_en: The list of virtual resource groups

items.description_en: The details of a virtual resource group

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the virtual resource group was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 虚拟资源组的创建时间

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the virtual resource group was last updated
UpdateTime.description_zh: 虚拟资源组的最后更新时间

VirtualResourceId.description_en: The ID of the virtual resource group

VirtualResourceName.description_en: The name of the virtual resource group
VirtualResourceName.title_en: 虚拟资源的名称，如果没有指定，默认和虚拟资源ID相同
VirtualResourceName.title_zh: 虚拟资源的名称，如果没有指定，默认和虚拟资源ID相同
